extension.description: Foreign direct investment (FDI) positions record the stock of cross-border equity and debt relationships where an investor holds at least 10 % of voting power in an enterprise, compiled according to the sixth edition of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6). Positions are shown for direct investment abroad and in the reporting economy, by assets, liabilities and net FDI, distinguishing immediate and ultimate counterpart countries and detailed NACE Rev. 2 activities, including special purpose entities.
